title: Pale Blue Dot
description: If you play enough cards in a turn, draw additional cards at the start of your next turn.
smart_description: If you play 5 or more cards in a turn, draw a number of additional cards equal to this power's stack level at the start of your next turn.
notes: Triggers once per turn when the player plays 5 or more cards. Amount drawn equals the number of stacks of this power.
